title: After EA, Saudi Arabia Is Reportedly Setting Its Sights On One Of Gaming’s Biggest Engines
description: Unity Software is reportedly being eyed as the next acquisition by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and a consortium of investors, including US private equity firm Silver Lake Partners. According to Reuters, Unity is already in talks with interested parties, with the software company reportedly valued as high as $25 billion, a significant increase from its current public price of $21.5 billion following its latest earnings report. Silver Lake already owns 8% of Unity, and talks are said to be in place as Unity considers the best options moving forward. If the company is sold, it'll represent another major investment by Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund and partners into the gaming industry, following the recent acquisition of Electronic Arts for $55 billion (that Silver Lake was also involved in). That takeover hasn't been without controversy, as the billions in leveraged debt that EA was saddled with has forced the company to make drastic cuts across the board, including the heavily criticized decision to shut down fan-favorite developer BioWare. Alongside its ownership of several studios--like mobile game developer Scopely--and stakes in gaming publishers like Nintendo and Capcom, a Unity acquisition could result in Saudi Arabia having an even bigger influence in the industry. Unity is the second-most popular game-development engine after Epic's Unreal, and it has been used to power multiple hit games, from indie hits like Hollow Knight and Among Us to live-service juggernauts like Genshin Impact. Unity is also used for far more than just game development, as the software is a popular choice for car designers, filmmakers, and architects. While it's far from a done deal, the rumors have already had a positive effect on Unity as its shares rose nearly 15% following Reuters' report. This also comes after several controversial years for the company, as Unity planned to introduce a new fee for game developers based on game installs back in 2023. The move…

title: "It's a brave new world": GTA 6's PC port will release sooner than you think to avoid losing money to AI rip-offs, says former Rockstar tech director
description: GTA 6 's PC release may come sooner than anticipated, according to former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij, because Rockstar and publishers Take-Two will be concerned about losing money to unofficial generative AI clones of the PS5 version, once it launches on 19th November. In general, Vermeij thinks that how to avoid having your games duplicated by chatbot herders is "the big question" right now for devs and publishers, particularly those who don't have the means to enforce their intellectual property dominions as vehemently as Take-Two do for Grand Theft Auto. Speaking to me during a wide-ranging chatathon, Vermeij reflected on the early days of Grand Theft Auto development at Rockstar North in the 90s, and how the Noel-and-Liam-Gallagher-esque relationship between PC and console gaming has evolved. He shared a sweary anecdote about the company's difficulties getting the original GTA 1 to look the business on Sony's PlayStation. Read more

title: People Are Acting Weird As Hell During Fortnite’s Treasure Hunt
description: Fortnite's new Treasure Hunters season is such a massive success that the battle royale's player counts are five times higher than last week, because everybody and their mothers want in on the search for Tim Sweeney's golden ticket. It grants everything in the item shop for free, both for two weeks this year and two more weeks in 2027. That means two things: Most of the people playing Fortnite right now haven't been playing recently, and folks aren't necessarily playing to win. The way the hunt works is that every time you or one of your teammates opens a treasure chest, there's a chance that a rare prize will be granted to the whole party. It could be a golden A$AP Rocky skin, a Mercedes G-Wagon skin, or the extremely elusive Pirate Shop Access token, which makes virtually the whole shop free. The hunt for that Pirate Shop token in particular has changed the way people play BR. The primary goal for many players is now not to win, but to open as many chests as possible in pursuit of the token. Since your whole squad gets any of these treasures regardless of who found them, four-player Squad fills have been the place to go for the hunt--understandably, most of us don't have enough friends who want to play Fortnite 12 hours a day to keep the squad filled on our own. Playing Squad fills has always been a bit of crapshoot in terms of the quality of your teammates, but the new treasure hunt has folks acting a lot more erratic than usual. While playing entirely too much Fortnite this week, I've identified a few player profiles--let's call them recurring characters--that I've been encountering over and over again. While your teammates each game are randomly assigned, they typically follow one of a handful of archetypes during the hunt. I've played about 100 games of Squad fills since the new Treasure Hunters mini-season began on Sunday, and nearly all of my teammates ended up being one of these types of players. title: The Best Zombie Game Of 2026 Just Went From George Romero To Jason Voorhees
description: Being obsessed with zombie fiction for as long as I have been, I'm comfortable saying No More Room in Hell 2 is the year's best zombie game. Since I first played it in early access two years ago, I've loved its Romero-inspired vibes and slower, more punishing take on a Left 4 Dead-style game--doubling the co-op team size to eight players is a fun wrinkle, too. So imagine my surprise when I recently hopped back into the game and found its latest update added a map that goes in a much different direction, trading its Night of the Living Dead inspirations for something much more at home in Friday the 13th. The Camp Blood update brings a slasher-inspired summer-camp map, Ruby Lake, to the game's wave-based Survival mode, which lives alongside its more campaign-like Scenario mode. Not that I wasn't open to the pivot, but as a horror obsessive, I wanted to know what inspired the new direction, even as the game's Romero-esque core is still well-represented in all other maps and modes. "Romero is ingrained in our DNA as far back as the original game, but we've always said that films and television, more than other games, are our main source of inspiration. This inspiration transcends just Romero and extends into horror as a broader theme," creative principal Matt Kazan told me via email, going on to name a parade of my favorite things ( plus CW's long-running monster-of-the-week series ). "Whether it's Stephen King, '80s slashers, Alfred Hitchcock, Evil Dead, Supernatural, or even weird stuff like Lost or Twin Peaks, and even Backrooms, our inspirations come from all sorts of places." Associate art director Jon Wiley expanded on that point, explaining how future updates will sometimes bring similarly surprising twists to the world, but not without purpose. Maps are "heavily influenced by the stories we want to tell," he said, adding that their maps are meant to have the same thematic relevance as Romero had in mind when he cast a black man in a major role in Night of the…

title: EA Killed Mass Effect But Is Still Trying To Make Money On It
description: Electronic Arts recently killed off Mass Effect and closed developer BioWare entirely, but the publisher is still trying to make money from the franchise's fanbase. Ahead of the annual Mass Effect holiday of N7 Day on November 7, EA is promoting Mass Effect via posts about what fans can buy on the BioWare Gear Store. A lot of people online are saying this is tone deaf and gross behavior. The BioWare Gear Store's social media presence came back to life after a month of darkness today to start hawking Mass Effect merch. The post that kicked things off is the one below, in which fans are invited to "celebrate the legacy" of Mass Effect by giving EA money. EA followed the post up with eight more, pushing people to visit the BioWare Gear Store to buy things like mugs, tote bags, clothing, and shoes, among other things. The replies under every one of the posts call out how cold and gross it is to promote the brand so soon after cancelling Mass Effect 5 and closing BioWare. EA made the drastic changes as part of a big organizational shift and wider pullback that also included layoffs and other game cancellations, like a new The Sims game. These moves came after EA was taken private by an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund in a deal that included billions of debt. It subsequently was reported that EA chose to pursue a new Star Wars Battlefront game over funding the next Mass Effect and BioWare's continued operation. A Change.org petition to "save Mass Effect" has drawn 300,000+ signatures, and Canadians are rallying their lawmakers to step in and fund the continued future of BioWare.

title: Buy Games On Prime? Your Membership Now Gets You Free Uber Eats Delivery, Too
description: If you're among the millions of Amazon Prime subscribers--maybe you use the platform to buy games--you're getting a new perk in the form of free delivery with Uber Eats. Amazon and Uber today announced a partnership where US Prime subscribers can get free delivery on orders of $25 or more. Orders can be placed on Amazon's website or through the app, as opposed to the Uber Eats app. The benefit works for Prime members in the US, including the cheaper Prime for Young Adults and Prime Access membership tiers. Additionally, Uber Eats is offering $20 off each of your first two orders of $25 or more through November 18. With this added perk, you can order some wings or a burrito to enjoy after buying GTA 6, all within one app. And that's the whole idea: Amazon does these partnerships to help keep you subscribed. Lucia and Jason in GTA 6. It bears mentioning that Amazon is a good place to buy games, but it's not perfect or without issue. In fact, a lot of Nintendo fans are upset with the marketplace for delaying their Ocarina of Time remake deliveries. Here are some more detailed instructions on how this works, as written by Amazon: Prime members can visit www.amazon.com/ubereats or open the Amazon Shopping app and search “Uber Eats” to get started in three simple steps. Log in with existing Amazon credentials, browse from nearby restaurants, and then place an order with existing Amazon payment methods. Once an order is placed, Amazon will send email and push notifications with delivery status updates, and Uber Eats will follow up with a final order confirmation.

title: Switch 2 Won’t Get Another Price Hike, At Least Not Soon, Nintendo Says
description: As part of Nintendo's latest earnings briefing, the company said it has no plans to increase the Switch 2 price again, or at least not anytime soon. VGC reported that management said Nintendo has enough memory stockpiled to shield itself and thus not need to implement another price hike. Nintendo raised the price of the Switch 2 in September, bringing it up from $450 to $500. This followed price hikes for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles, meaning that all three major platforms have seen hikes. The price increases are the result of macroeconomic factors including tariffs and the demand for memory and components from AI companies. Following the US midterm elections, technology stocks--and specifically AI stocks--have massively sold off, at least temporarily. It remains to be seen when or if there would be any relief on the memory and component market, though. Nintendo also reported in its earnings briefing that it received many millions in tariff refunds, but the company is keeping all of it for themselves, just like PlayStation and other companies are doing with their own refunds. Nintendo had a tone-deaf and cringey tariff sale. Nintendo's latest big game release was The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake for Switch 2, and it's the best-reviewed game of 2026 overall.
